--- a/token-master-plugin/skills/token-master/brainspace/v6_shaping.py
+++ b/token-master-plugin/skills/token-master/brainspace/v6_shaping.py
@@ -135,6 +135,47 @@ def fold_paths(text: str) -> str | None:
     return result if len(result) < len(text) else None
 
 
+def unfold_paths(text: object) -> str | None:
+    """Losslessly invert ``fold_paths`` output; return ``None`` for any invalid or non-canonical form."""
+    if type(text) is not str or not text:
+        return None
+    trailing = text[len(text.rstrip("\n")):]
+    lines = text.split("\n")
+    while lines and not lines[-1]:
+        lines.pop()
+    entries: list[str] = []
+    notices: list[str] = []
+    current: str | None = None
+    count_under = 0
+    for line in lines:
+        if not line:
+            return None
+        if _NOTICE.match(line):
+            if current is not None and count_under == 0:
+                return None
+            notices.append(line)
+        elif notices:
+            return None
+        elif line.startswith("  "):
+            name = line[2:]
+            if current is None or not name or name.startswith(" "):
+                return None
+            prefix = "" if current == "." else current
+            entries.append(prefix + name)
+            count_under += 1
+        else:
+            if current is not None and count_under == 0:
+                return None
+            if line != "." and not line.endswith(("\\", "/")):
+                return None
+            current = line
+            count_under = 0
+    if current is None or count_under == 0 or len(entries) < 3:
+        return None
+    result = "\n".join(entries + notices) + trailing
+    return result if fold_paths(result) == text else None
+
+
 def _digest_lines(text: str, budget: int, count: Callable[[str], int], total: int, kind: str,
                   folded: bool) -> str:
     lines = text.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
